neighbours.label: the token at or just after a mid-sentence opening quote or dash that interrupts the sentence (“fell to pieces”, decade–crashed)
fire: The coach said the defence had been, in his words, “completely asleep” all night.
Housing prices–which had climbed for a decade–finally fell.
The critic called the play “a tedious mess” in her review.
Our neighbour–a retired pilot–fixed the fence for free.
According to the mayor, the budget “simply does not add up.”
The storm–the worst in years–knocked out power across the county.
He described the meeting as “mostly shouting” and left early.
The old bridge–built in 1890–will be replaced next spring.
